output: Trade is the exchange of goods and services between people or countries.
A mortgage is a loan used to buy a house, paid back over many years.
A budget is a plan for how to spend and save money.
A bank is a financial institution that accepts deposits and makes loans.
Saving is keeping money for future use instead of spending it now.
An expense is money spent on goods and services.
Entrepreneurship is starting and running a new business.
A loss is when costs are greater than revenue.
Wealth is having a lot of money, property, or other valuable assets.
Poverty is not having enough money to meet basic needs.
